title: A module that owns a changed file may be declared without a delta
description: A module that owns a changed file may be declared without a delta
acceptance_criteria: a change declaring auth and sessions with a delta only for sessions, whose declared file src/auth.rs auth owns, is approved, materialized, verified and accepted, with the sessions delta applied and the auth spec untouched; the same scope over a file only sessions owns is refused at approval naming auth

answers.constraints: at least one affected module still carries a delta; a delta must still name an affected spec; an approved delta deleted later is still reported as changed after approval
